newsitem.title: FRANCE: Parliament demands aid freeze for Belarus.
newsitem.headline: Parliament demands aid freeze for Belarus.

text.p: The European Parliament, reacting to perceived irregularities in Belarus's November elections, on Thursday urged the European Union to stop support and financial aid to the country.
The assembly said that only democracy-related aid under the TACIS democracy programme -- which includes measures to support a free and independent media -- should be maintained.

The parliament confirmed an earlier statement that it would go no further with ratification of a planned cooperation and partnership accord with Minsk until "clear signals had been given by the Belarus authorities of their intention fully to respect basic democratic and human rights."
The parliament said the EU should use its weight to pressure international organisations to freeze their own aid in a bid to force democracy in Belarus.
Hardline President Alexander Lukashenko has been criticised in the West for using a huge victory in a November 24 referenedm to rewrite the constitution and grant himself sweeping powers.
